notes: 英文是在遊戲外執行模組註冊文字的程式記錄下來的；模組另外內建西班牙文，那部分不收錄。
ACHIEVEMENT_ 開頭的是解鎖造型或技能的成就。
形態熟練度（Mastery）的提示，以及 Kizuna 羈絆模組（Zerneas-KizunaMod）的大廳、標題畫面與技能清單介面，文字寫死在程式裡（只有英文和西班牙文），不經過語言表，翻不到。
FROGCALL 與 ODAMA 是用成就（六道、妙木山修行）解鎖的隱藏技能。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_DESCRIPTION.en:
Sage Naruto fights with the patience of the toads: calm gathers natural energy, and natural energy makes his jutsu enormous.<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! > Keep still to meditate and fill your four charges of natural energy; your hidden clones bring charges too.

< ! > Every Frog Kumite blow gives you a point of natural energy, with no limit. Your next Sage Art spends them all.

< ! > Tap a Sage Art to use it at once, or hold it to pour charges in: bigger, it catches more enemies.

< ! > Clone Catapult, then Big Ball Rasengan aimed down: a meteor onto the crowd.

< ! > Chakra control: hold Jump against a wall to run on it.

< ! > Fighting fills your fury: from a quarter, press X to become the Six-Tails. Let it run out and Sage Mode breaks.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW:
仙人模式鳴人以蛤蟆般的耐心作戰：心靜才能匯聚自然能量，而自然能量能讓他的忍術變得無比巨大。<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! >保持靜止即可冥想，填滿四次自然能量充能；潛伏的分身也會為你帶來充能。

< ! >蛙組手每次命中都會給你1點自然能量，沒有上限。下一次仙法會將其全數消耗。

< ! >輕按仙法可立即施放，按住則可灌注充能：術越大，波及的敵人越多。

< ! >先用分身投擲，再朝下施放大玉螺旋丸：彷彿一顆隕石砸向敵群。

< ! >查克拉控制：貼著牆按住跳躍鍵就能在牆上奔跑。

< ! >戰鬥會累積怒氣：累積到四分之一後，按X鍵化為六尾。若任怒氣耗盡，仙人模式就會解除。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_LORE.en: He learned to stand as still as a toad on Mount Myoboku, until nature itself flowed into him. Now the orange round his eyes means the fight is already decided.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_LORE.zh-TW: 他在妙木山學會像蛤蟆一樣靜止不動，直到大自然本身流入他的體內。如今，只要他的眼周泛起橙色，這場戰鬥就已經分出勝負了。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_OUTRO_FLAVOR.en: ..and so he left, at one with the world around him.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_OUTRO_FLAVOR.zh-TW: ……於是他走了，與周遭的世界融為一體。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_OUTRO_FAILURE.en: ..and so he vanished, the toads' teachings unfinished.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_OUTRO_FAILURE.zh-TW: ……於是他就這樣消逝了，蛤蟆們的教誨終究沒能學成。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_PASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.en: Up to <style=cIsUtility>4 charges of natural energy</style>, full every stage: <style=cIsUtility>meditating</style> (still, on the ground) gives 1 a second, your hidden clones 1 every 8s. Every Frog Kumite blow that lands gives <style=cIsDamage>1 point of natural energy</style> (15s, no limit) and reaches 50% farther. <style=cIsUtility>Sage Arts</style>: your Secondary and Special spend every point as they land, <style=cIsDamage>70% damage a point</style>; hold them to pour charges in and make them bigger.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_PASSIVE_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: 最多<style=cIsUtility>4次自然能量充能</style>，每個關卡都會充滿：<style=cIsUtility>冥想</style>（在地面上保持靜止）每秒獲得1次，潛伏的分身每8秒帶來1次。蛙組手每次命中都會給予<style=cIsDamage>1點自然能量</style>（持續15秒，沒有上限），且攻擊距離增加50%。<style=cIsUtility>仙法</style>：你的次要技能與特殊技能命中時會消耗所有點數，<style=cIsDamage>每點增加70%傷害</style>；按住技能可灌注充能，使其變得更大。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_PRIMARY_KUMITE_DESCRI.en: <style=cIsUtility>Agile.</style> Four blows for <style=cIsDamage>150%</style> (a clone joins the 2nd and 3rd for <style=cIsDamage>80%</style>) and a finisher for <style=cIsDamage>320%</style> that knocks back. In the air, blows for <style=cIsDamage>150%</style>; looking down, a diving Rasengan Barrage: <style=cIsDamage>300%</style> in 5m.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_PRIMARY_KUMITE_DESCRI.zh-TW: <style=cIsUtility>靈巧</style>。四連擊，每擊造成<style=cIsDamage>150%</style>傷害（第2、3擊會有分身加入，造成<style=cIsDamage>80%</style>傷害），再以終結技造成<style=cIsDamage>320%</style>傷害並擊退敵人。在空中時連擊造成<style=cIsDamage>150%</style>傷害；朝下看時改為俯衝施放螺旋連丸：在半徑5米內造成<style=cIsDamage>300%</style>傷害。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SECONDARY_RASENGAN_DE.en: Charge up to 12m with a Big Ball Rasengan: <style=cIsDamage>900%</style> in 6m, <style=cIsDamage>stunning</style>. <style=cIsUtility>Sage Art</style>: <style=cIsDamage>+70%</style> a point; each charge poured, <style=cIsDamage>+450%</style> and +2.25m.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SECONDARY_RASENGAN_DE.zh-TW: 帶著大玉螺旋丸衝鋒最多12米：在半徑6米內造成<style=cIsDamage>900%</style>傷害並<style=cIsDamage>眩暈</style>。<style=cIsUtility>仙法</style>：每點<style=cIsDamage>+70%</style>；每灌注1次充能，<style=cIsDamage>+450%</style>且範圍+2.25米。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_UTILITY_CATAPULT_DESC.en: Two clones <style=cIsUtility>throw you</style> toward the crosshair. <style=cIsUtility>Invulnerable</style> for 0.5s; <style=cIsDamage>stuns</style> enemies within 6m.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_UTILITY_CATAPULT_DESC.zh-TW: 兩個分身將你<style=cIsUtility>拋向</style>準星方向。<style=cIsUtility>無敵</style>0.5秒；<style=cIsDamage>眩暈</style>6米內的敵人。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_UTILITY_FROGCALL_DESC.en: Fukasaku and Shima croak a sound wave toward the crosshair: <style=cIsDamage>200%</style> in 25m, <style=cIsDamage>stunning</style> for 1.5s. Bosses are <style=cIsUtility>slowed</style> instead.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_UTILITY_FROGCALL_DESC.zh-TW: 深作與志麻朝準星方向發出一道蛙鳴音波：在25米範圍內造成<style=cIsDamage>200%</style>傷害，並<style=cIsDamage>眩暈</style>1.5秒。首領則改為<style=cIsUtility>減速</style>。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SPECIAL_RASENSHURIKEN.en: A 8m sphere of wind blades that <style=cIsUtility>pulls enemies in</style>: <style=cIsDamage>10x100%</style>, then <style=cIsDamage>500%</style> as it bursts. <style=cIsUtility>Sage Art</style>: <style=cIsDamage>+70%</style> a point; each charge poured, <style=cIsDamage>+35%</style> and +1.88m.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SPECIAL_RASENSHURIKEN.zh-TW: 產生8米的風刃球體，將敵人<style=cIsUtility>吸入</style>：造成<style=cIsDamage>10x100%</style>傷害，爆炸時再造成<style=cIsDamage>500%</style>傷害。<style=cIsUtility>仙法</style>：每點<style=cIsDamage>+70%</style>；每灌注1次充能，<style=cIsDamage>+35%</style>且範圍+1.88米。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SPECIAL_ODAMA_NAME.en: Sage Art: Twin Big Ball Rasengan

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SPECIAL_ODAMA_DESCRIP.en: Two clones plunge onto the crosshair with a giant Rasengan each: <style=cIsDamage>2x800%</style> in 7m, one blow each. <style=cIsUtility>Sage Art</style>: <style=cIsDamage>+70%</style> a point; each charge poured, <style=cIsDamage>+250%</style> per ball and +1.5m.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SPECIAL_ODAMA_DESCRIP.zh-TW: 兩個分身各帶著一顆巨大的螺旋丸衝向準星位置：在半徑7米內造成<style=cIsDamage>2x800%</style>傷害，每顆只會擊中一次。<style=cIsUtility>仙法</style>：每點<style=cIsDamage>+70%</style>；每灌注1次充能，每顆<style=cIsDamage>+250%</style>且範圍+1.5米。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SIXTAILS_DESCRIPTION.en: <style=cIsDamage>Fury</style> fills as you fight. From <style=cIsUtility>25%</style>, become the Six-Tails with a roar for <style=cIsDamage>300%</style> in 10m. <style=cIsUtility>+40 armor</style>, <style=cIsUtility>+30% speed</style>, no stuns; fury drains 5% a second. Turn back with X: the fury left becomes <style=cIsDamage>natural energy</style>. If it <style=cIsHealth>runs out</style>, you <style=cIsHealth>lose Sage Mode</style>.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SIXTAILS_DESCRIPTION.zh-TW: <style=cIsDamage>怒氣</style>會在戰鬥中累積。達<style=cIsUtility>25%</style>即可化為六尾，並發出咆哮，在半徑10米內造成<style=cIsDamage>300%</style>傷害。<style=cIsUtility>+40護甲</style>、<style=cIsUtility>+30%移動速度</style>，免疫眩暈；怒氣每秒減少5%。按X鍵解除：剩餘的怒氣會轉為<style=cIsDamage>自然能量</style>。若怒氣<style=cIsHealth>耗盡</style>，你會<style=cIsHealth>失去仙人模式</style>。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SIXTAILS_CLAWS_DESCRI.en: <style=cIsUtility>Agile.</style> Spring at the enemy and tear into it: <style=cIsDamage>250%</style>, <style=cIsDamage>250%</style> throwing it up, then a slam for <style=cIsDamage>400%</style> in 5m. In the air, claws for <style=cIsDamage>250%</style>; looking down, a dive for <style=cIsDamage>400%</style>.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SIXTAILS_CLAWS_DESCRI.zh-TW: <style=cIsUtility>靈巧</style>。撲向敵人撕扯：<style=cIsDamage>250%</style>、<style=cIsDamage>250%</style>並將其拋起，接著重擊地面，在半徑5米內造成<style=cIsDamage>400%</style>傷害。在空中時以爪擊造成<style=cIsDamage>250%</style>傷害；朝下看時改為俯衝，造成<style=cIsDamage>400%</style>傷害。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SIXTAILS_CANNON_DESCR.en: <style=cIsDamage>3 homing blasts</style>: <style=cIsDamage>300%</style> in 4m each. In the air, one for <style=cIsDamage>500%</style>.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SIXTAILS_CANNON_DESCR.zh-TW: 發射<style=cIsDamage>3發追蹤炮彈</style>：每發在半徑4米內造成<style=cIsDamage>300%</style>傷害。在空中時改為發射1發，造成<style=cIsDamage>500%</style>傷害。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SIXTAILS_RAMPAGE_DESC.en: Roar (<style=cIsDamage>100%</style>, slowing) and run with rage for up to 3s: <style=cIsDamage>300%</style> and a <style=cIsDamage>stun</style> to everything you trample. Press again to <style=cIsDamage>crash down</style>: <style=cIsDamage>400%</style> in 7m.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SIXTAILS_RAMPAGE_DESC.zh-TW: 咆哮（<style=cIsDamage>100%</style>，並使敵人減速），接著狂暴奔馳最多3秒：對踐踏到的一切造成<style=cIsDamage>300%</style>傷害並使其<style=cIsDamage>眩暈</style>。再按一次可<style=cIsDamage>猛然砸地</style>：在半徑7米內造成<style=cIsDamage>400%</style>傷害。

ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SIXTAILS_BIJUUDAMA_DE.en: Explodes for <style=cIsDamage>1500%</style> in 12m. Hold to <style=cIsDamage>pour fury</style> in: <style=cIsDamage>+500%</style> and +3m each, up to 3.
ZERNEAS_NARUTOSAGE_SIXTAILS_BIJUUDAMA_DE.zh-TW: 爆炸，在半徑12米內造成<style=cIsDamage>1500%</style>傷害。按住可<style=cIsDamage>灌注怒氣</style>：每次<style=cIsDamage>+500%</style>且範圍+3米，最多3次。

ACHIEVEMENT_ZERNEASNARUTOSAGECLEARGAMEMO.en: As Sage Naruto, beat the game or obliterate on Monsoon.
ACHIEVEMENT_ZERNEASNARUTOSAGECLEARGAMEMO.zh-TW: 作為仙人模式鳴人，在季風難度下通關遊戲或抹除自己。

ACHIEVEMENT_ZERNEASNARUTOSAGECLEARMERIDI.zh-TW: 仙人模式鳴人：學生制服

ACHIEVEMENT_ZERNEASNARUTOSAGECLEARMERIDI.en: As Sage Naruto, defeat the False Son.
ACHIEVEMENT_ZERNEASNARUTOSAGECLEARMERIDI.zh-TW: 作為仙人模式鳴人，打敗虛假子嗣。

ACHIEVEMENT_ZERNEASNARUTOSAGESIXPATHS_DE.en: As Sage Naruto, kill 6 enemies with a single Sage Art.
ACHIEVEMENT_ZERNEASNARUTOSAGESIXPATHS_DE.zh-TW: 作為仙人模式鳴人，用一次仙法擊敗6名敵人。

ACHIEVEMENT_ZERNEASNARUTOSAGEMYOBOKU_NAM.en: Sage Naruto: Training on Mount Myoboku
ACHIEVEMENT_ZERNEASNARUTOSAGEMYOBOKU_NAM.zh-TW: 仙人模式鳴人：妙木山修行

ACHIEVEMENT_ZERNEASNARUTOSAGEMYOBOKU_DES.en: As Sage Naruto, gather 20 charges of natural energy by meditating in a single run.
ACHIEVEMENT_ZERNEASNARUTOSAGEMYOBOKU_DES.zh-TW: 作為仙人模式鳴人，一輪遊戲中靠冥想累積20次自然能量充能。
